text: Added shared AtlasParityFixtures and AtlasParityCorpusSuite for non-contiguous IDs, metadata, query/reduce/overlap, NaN mask behavior, and invalid metadata/payload cases; added JVM synthetic NIfTI loader fixtures for Schaefer and Glasser loadFromPaths; added optional neuroatlas R parity checker. Verified with sbt atlasJVM/test atlasJS/test and Rscript tools/r-parity/check_neuroatlas_atlas_parity.R.
